statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let countHits := fun a x p : ℕ => ((window x p).filter (fun n => p ∣ n^2+a)).card; let inc := fun a x : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ primes x, (countHits a x p : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let model := fun a x : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ primes x, ((window x p).card : ℝ) * ((roots a p).card : ℝ) / p * Real.log (p : ℝ); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ x : ℕ, inc 1 x = model 1 x + modes 1 x true + modes 1 x false

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0019 · Recover first-incidence mass from the three frequency ranges

brief.zh: 对移动窗中每个 n 及每个根用完全正交，分出 k=0，再按 min(k,p−k) 截开。
brief.en: Apply orthogonality for each window element and root. Extract k=0 and split the rest at min(k,p−k)=⌊√p⌋.
